styleGuard._note: Measured directly from this recipe's first real generation — A1-ART-02 'Millcross' (a pre-industrial crossing town) rendered as a photorealistic MODERN settlement: white pickup trucks, an SUV, corrugated-metal roofing, a contemporary city skyline on the horizon. The ABP's own recorded workflow carried a bare prompt (it was measuring ControlNet strength, not style) and neither the brief prose nor the shared style-laws.json ruled out modern contamination — schnell defaults toward a photoreal modern read once style words are absent. REPLICATED 2026-08-03 (docs/worldbuilding/ABP-controlnet-replication.md) across the other three L1 briefs, two seeds, strengths 0.30/0.40: this list REDUCES but does not ELIMINATE modern contamination — 1 of 16 cells still showed SUV-like vehicles plus wooden utility poles/wires (Millcross, seed 741852), and 2 of 16 showed a hazy modern city skyline in the background (Cindervast, both seeds, strength 0.30) despite 'no modern vehicles'/'no modern city skyline' already being in this list. Two artifact classes this list does NOT target at all and should: a recurring electricity-transmission LATTICE-PYLON silhouette (5 of 16 cells, 3 of 4 subjects, clustered on seed 12345) and visibly cracked/rubbled walls on subjects whose brief explicitly calls for clean stonework (Cindervast, 4 of 4 cells).
